title: Week 2 Show-Me Time
note: Grown-up reads each prompt aloud. Rookie shows what they can do. Tap the happy face together for each one!

questions.q: Show counting to 10 on fingers, nice and slow
questions.why: Every number you touch builds strong counting muscles!

questions.q: Show counting to 20 with a wiggle at 15 and a big clap at 20
options: Counted to 20 with wiggle and clap
questions.why: Reaching 20 is a big milestone — great job!

questions.q: Make two groups of blocks and tap the group that has more
questions.why: Spotting 'more' helps your math brain grow!

questions.q: Line up toys, count them together, then add one more and count again
options: Counted toys, added one, counted again
questions.why: Adding one more shows you know what comes next!

questions.q: Sort items by color — put all green things together
questions.why: Sorting by color sharpens your noticing skills!

questions.q: Thread six beads onto a string, then do it again
questions.why: Each bead threaded is a tiny victory for strong fingers!
